_what_this_is: A version bump whose only changed path under changelog.d/ is a fragment it DELETES. It writes no entry, and it has to be refused for a-version-bump-carries-a-changelog-entry. Until #296 this document passed with zero blocking failures: the rule read the names of the changed files and not what happened to them, so a change that tidied one stale fragment out of the directory satisfied the rule the tidying had nothing to do with. Nothing else about this document is wrong, so a run over it that refuses for another rule proves nothing.
title: Bump the manifest and tidy the changelog directory (#116)
body:
Closes #116.

The fragment removed here went out with an earlier release, and the version moves in the same change.
